The animal has a robust, barrel-shaped body covered in coarse greyish-brown fur. Its head is broad with small eyes and rounded ears, and a large, dark nose. Short, powerful limbs are visible, supporting a low center of gravity. The tail is not clearly visible due to the angle and foliage.
